Engineered resilient extractions (CSS / XPath selectors, pagination, anti-bot techniques); wired outputs to Google Sheets, MySQL, a headless CMS and webhooks.
Authored troubleshooting guides, trained internal and external support teams, and directed weekly production releases with change management and impact analysis.

Improved work efficiency ~50% through system updates; trained employees, boosting productivity ~40%.
